name: frag_record_verb
description: Phase 6: standalone <Record> is now implemented via the core FreeSWITCH `record` app. It writes a WAV to the tenant-scoped shared spool (/media/spool/recordings/customer_<id>/<uuid>.wav) and POSTs metadata to the API recordings-ingest. With no action/callback it records then falls through to the next verb. (playBeep defaults true; maxLength=20 here.)
